owner_direction: 現実データは母数があった方がいいだろうから 取れるならたくさん取って研究に使えるようにしておきな

authorized: increase the number of narrowly captured pre-race public research samples
preserve reusable normalized research facts and provenance
derive calibration distributions/ranges/support sets from the expanded batch
not_authorized: redistribution of source pages or raw copied tables in the public repository
model selection or promotion from this burned calibration batch

capture_cap_v1.selection_basis: prespecified coverage across FI/FII, S/A1-A2/A3, multiple race stages, and 400m/500m venues; no outcome/model-based selection
capture_cap_v1.stop_rule: stop once 12 admissible races are captured or today's lawful pre-cutoff surfaces no longer support the prespecified sample

storage_rule: Keep reusable normalized facts privately where possible and public GitHub limited to derived/calibration evidence, provenance, hashes and non-identifying summaries; do not mirror source tables.
